【题材】：讲述一个穿着黑底红云长袍的黑发忍者结印释放忍术的过程。包含血月背景、红色发光眼睛特写、手部快速结印的残影、查克拉爆发衣服飘动、身后出现巨大红眼乌鸦幻影的震撼场景。
【画风】：写实3D风格，暗黑水墨特效，史诗感，高画质。
【时长】：30s
【角色档案】：
角色A：角色身穿黑底红云长袍，黑色长发，佩戴忍者护额，双眼为发光的红色瞳孔。
【分镜脚本】（共9个镜头，按从左到右、从上到下顺序）：

[0.00-6.50] Slow cinematic push-in on a massive blood-red moon hanging in a dark ink-splattered sky, crows silhouetted flying across the crimson glow, drifting black feathers, grim determination building in the atmosphere, volumetric moonlight, hyper-detailed dark fantasy watercolor style, cinematic 8k. Subtitle: "月圆之夜，乌鸦啼血。"

[6.50-10.50] Slow push-in on Itachi's face, red Sharingan eyes glowing beneath the Konoha forehead protector, ink-splattered crimson background, eyes narrowing with cold intensity, jaw tight, realistic face muscles tensing, no smiling, subtle red rim lighting, dark chiaroscuro, cinematic anime realism. Subtitle: "我背负着一切。"

[10.50-14.00] Low-angle tracking shot rising up his crossed hands forming the ram hand seal at his chest, black Akatsuki cloak with red clouds, drifting feathers around him, mouth set in grim resolve, eyes hidden in shadow, jaw clenched with determination, volumetric backlight, dark smoky atmosphere. Subtitle: "结印吧。"

[14.00-17.00] Handheld camera shake close on his hand forming a single-finger seal, wisps of dark chakra smoke swirling around his fingers, half his face lit red, lips parted in focused concentration, teeth grit, intense adrenaline in his shadowed eyes, no smiling, chiaroscuro lighting, volumetric smoke. Subtitle: "幻术，发动。"

[17.00-20.50] Dynamic orbiting shot around Itachi standing center-frame in swirling black ink and feather storm, cloak billowing violently, hands pressed in prayer seal, eyes wide with fierce intensity, mouth grimacing in effort, realistic straining face muscles, no smiling, monochrome ink-wash style with red accents, cinematic wind. Subtitle: "月读——世界，属于我了。"

[20.50-24.00] Push-in on Itachi's face, index finger raised to his lips in a silent "shh" gesture, glowing red Sharingan eyes locked to camera, cold menacing stare, subtle smirk-free grim expression, eyes narrowed with lethal calm, no smiling, dripping crimson ink background, dramatic red rim light. Subtitle: "别出声。"

[24.00-27.50] FPV shot, immersive first-person perspective, violent explosion of black crows and red ink erupting outward from Itachi's silhouette, high-speed cinematic movement, feathers and blood-red splatter flying past camera, face contorted with intense fury, mouth open yelling, teeth grit, eyes wide with adrenaline, no smiling, dynamic motion blur, dark fantasy watercolor chaos. Subtitle: "散——！"

[27.50-31.00] Low-angle hero shot, a giant blood-red crow with a burning red eye screaming behind Itachi, massive wings spread wide in crimson ink, Itachi standing resolute below, terrified yet resolute expression, brows furrowed, jaw locked, no smiling, splattered red-and-black watercolor, volumetric divine backlight, epic cinematic scale. Subtitle: "这就是宇智波的力量。"

[31.00-37.00] Slow cinematic pull-back, Itachi standing alone at center in a storm of drifting feathers and dispersing red mist, hands lowering slowly from the prayer seal, weary grim expression, eyes closing with quiet sorrow, tired resolute face, no smiling, soft volumetric light fading, ink-wash minimalist composition, emotional epilogue. Subtitle: "原谅我……佐助。这是最后一次了。"
